page.layout: One page of text, no columns and no margin notes. Heading block at the top under a decorative border, then three stanzas of verse. Signature mark at the foot.

main_text.head: ADMONITIO ad Regem Christianissimum HENRICVM IIII, SVPER RESTITVTIONE Iesuitarum,

p.i: FRANÇORVM sūmas qui nūc moderaris habenas, Inrag[?], Francigenis summa cum laude ministras Inclyte Rex, sit pace tua mihi pauca referre Concessum, facilisque animo mea dicta reconde, Vera canam, liceat tantum mihi dicere vera.

main_text.p: Tertius HENRICVS, cuius nunc sceptra tueris, AVGERIVM coluit patris instar, eique salutem Credidit, & summo semper veneratus honore est, Ignorans quod CHRISTE tuum qui nomen ubique Et vitam iactent, studia in contraria currant: Tantum sæpe valet sanctæ simulatio vitæ.

Sed postquam sese falsa sub imagine recti, Mendacique diu pietatis fallier umbra Sensisset, moresque tuos IVDAITA notasset, Tandem poenituit: Quis enim mage crederet illis, Nomine qui CHRISTI scelera atq; piacula velant? Queis magis in votis nihil est, quam nomine SANCTI FOEDERIS, e solis Dominos depellere avitis, Et Reges iugulare pios, populumque fidelem in proprios animare Duces, & ad arma ciere,

page.notes: Uncertain: the first word of line 2 after "Inrag" is blurred under the large initial; read as "Inrag[?]". "Inrag" may be a printing error. The large F of the opening word is set as an initial and is joined to "RANÇORVM". Ornament border at the top and show-through text omitted. Page number 291 printed at the head. Signature "T 2" at the foot. No running head and no catchword.
